scope: Historical diagnostic flat self sample percentages; different populated caches and absolute paths, equal relative fixture bytes; no wall-time or current-main claim
limitations: Flat reports cannot recover per-event DWARF stack coverage or establish hash callers; stack_coverage is null. Equal children/self percentages on host hash rows provide no cumulative caller attribution.

Unresolved and planner memfd self samples cannot be attributed to component functions. Category totals overlap except the combined hashing categories, whose inputs are disjoint; do not sum all categories.
CPU and wall include perf/snapshot overhead. Paired uninstrumented benchmarks are required for performance claims.
Perf header decoding diagnostics are retained; successful flat decoding does not repair missing event metadata.
Symbol-cache diagnostics are retained even when buildid-cache exits zero; exit zero alone does not prove symbol indexing succeeded.
